user_query: I'm planning a surprise baby shower for my sister. Help me find a list of available domains to create a special website for the event. Additionally, suggest some baby shower games and decorations, and recommend a reliable URL link shortener API to create branded short links for the event invitations.

TaskList.description: Search for available domain names for the baby shower website.
Gather suggestions for baby shower games and decorations.
Find a reliable URL link shortener API that can create branded short links.
Compile a comprehensive guide that includes domain suggestions, games, decorations, and the chosen URL shortener.
